summary: I’m Joshua , a multidisciplinary technologist passionate about transforming complexity into clarity. My journey bridges three worlds: Data Analytics & Science/Web — uncovering insights, building predictive models, and translating raw data into actionable strategies. AI/ML/DL Engineering — designing intelligent systems, training deep learning architectures, and pushing the boundaries of machine learning applications. Full Stack Development — crafting scalable, user-focused applications from front-end design to back-end infrastructure. What drives me is curiosity and impact. I thrive on solving problems that matter — whether it’s optimizing workflows, automating decisions, or creating digital products that empower people. Beyond the code, I value collaboration, continuous learning, and the art of connecting ideas across disciplines. My portfolio is a reflection of that mindset: a space where data meets design, and innovation meets execution. In short: I don’t just build solutions — I engineer possibilities.

entries.title: Cloud Gallery: High-Performance PHP Cloud Storage Gateway
entries.summary: Stratum is an enterprise-grade, lightweight Cloud Storage Gateway built in PHP that seamlessly bridges legacy on-premise applications with modern cloud object storage providers. By implementing a highly optimized PSR-7 compatible streaming architecture, Stratum solves the memory bottleneck typically associated with PHP file handling, allowing petabyte-scale data transfers with minimal memory footprints. It features a robust multi-provider adapter pattern supporting AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, and Azure Blob, local Redis-backed metadata caching for sub-millisecond directory listings, and resilient chunked parallel uploads. This gateway enables organizations to modernize their storage infrastructure without rewriting legacy codebase dependencies, significantly reducing egress costs and operational complexity.

entries.title: xMachine: Browser-Based Deep Learning & Inference Platform
entries.summary: TensorWeb is a powerful, end-to-end AI/ML/DL web integrator designed to democratize machine learning by enabling users to import datasets, train models, and run real-time inferences directly in the browser. By leveraging client-side hardware acceleration and robust backend synchronization, the platform eliminates complex local environment setups and high cloud-compute costs. It features a comprehensive suite of tools supporting Computer Vision classification, real-time Object Detection, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), and lightweight Large Language Model (LLM) training. Engineered with a highly responsive Next.js frontend, MongoDB for dataset and model metadata management, and TensorFlow/TensorFlow.js for seamless cross-platform model compilation, TensorWeb redefines the accessibility of modern deep learning workflows.
bullets: Stack: TensorFlow.js, Next.js, MongoDB, TensorFlow, WebGPU, React, Node.js

entries.title: NotePad: Dual-Engine Cross-Platform Note Suite
entries.summary: A high-performance, offline-first note-taking ecosystem developed simultaneously in Flutter and React Native to benchmark and showcase cross-platform architectural patterns. OmniNote features a robust markdown editing engine, real-time local-first synchronization using conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs), and end-to-end encryption. The project highlights advanced state management (BLoC/Provider for Flutter, Zustand Toolkit for React Native) and demonstrates how to achieve 60fps rich-text rendering and seamless SQLite-backed data persistence across both framework ecosystems.
bullets: Stack: Flutter, React Native, Dart, TypeScript, SQLite, CRDT, Markdown Parser
